narrative.overview:
The page is a launch stage with the house lights down. A near-black floor (light mode: an off-white one with near-black ink) carries no colour of its own. Colour walks on with each product, as that product's own field, hairline and link colour, lifted from its own design tokens. The hero object is a real phone playing the real app: a flat CSS device with a true bezel, tilted back in perspective, that straightens as you scroll and stays pinned while the Bitewise story passes it.

Density is generous and editorial: large tight Geist headings, long measure-capped leads in a muted ink, and numbers set in Geist Mono as data rather than decoration. Surfaces are flat and separated by tone and alpha hairlines; the phone is the only thing that casts a shadow. Motion is short and soft (one ease-out curve, 160 to 560 ms), comes from scroll and press, and disappears under Reduce Motion. Dark is the first theme; light is a full counterpart, and both resolve from one `light-dark()` token each.

The system refuses the template portfolio (name, skills list, grid of same-size project cards) and the SaaS split hero with a badge row.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral stage, hue 260 at near-zero chroma; no site accent.
Product colour only as a field, line and accent scoped to that product (Bitewise matcha, Ascend persimmon, Orbit blue).
Geist set large and tight at weight 600; Geist Mono only for data, tabular.
Flat, tonal layering with alpha hairlines; one lifted object, the phone.
Concentric corners: an outer radius is the inner radius plus the padding between them.
In-house 1.5-stroke line icons on a 24-unit grid.
Every unsupplied asset shows as a dashed, bracketed placeholder.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The site owns no accent. Colour enters only as a product's field, line and accent, taken from that product's own tokens and scoped to that product's tile or story. A project without its own palette gets a neutral `bg-raised` tile.

rules.name: The Ink Action Rule
rules.body: The primary action is solid ink on the page colour. Inside a product tile, links take that product's accent through `--accent`; everywhere else they are ink.

rules.name: The One Line Per Token Rule
rules.body: Every theme-dependent colour is a single `light-dark(<light>, <dark>)` declaration resolved by `color-scheme`. No dark-mode override blocks. `lib/palette.test.ts` reads these lines and checks every text colour on every surface at 4.5:1, so keep each token on one line in that shape.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only where the content is data: numbers, metadata, recorded-on captions, agent names, bracketed placeholders. Always tabular. Never for prose or the four heading levels; an agent's name is the one heading set in mono, because it is an identifier.

rules.name: The Tightening Scale Rule
rules.body: All four heading steps are weight 600, and tracking tightens as size grows (-0.024em at title to -0.038em at display), with line height falling toward 1.

rules.name: The One Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: Only the phone casts a shadow. Tiles, buttons, the nav and the pipeline stay flat and separate by tone and hairline.

rules.name: The Concentric Corner Rule
rules.body: An outer radius equals the inner radius plus the space between them: tile radius = 14 px + tile padding; phone radius = screen radius + bezel.

dos: **Do** give every new colour one `light-dark()` line in `:root` and add its text pairs to `lib/palette.test.ts` at 4.5:1 (3:1 for non-text marks).
**Do** bring a new project's colour from its own tokens as a `-field`, `-accent` and `-line` triple, and scope it to that project's tile or story.
**Do** set every count in Geist Mono with tabular figures, in full ink beside a muted label.
**Do** build radii concentrically: outer = inner + padding.
**Do** keep every target at least 44 px and pair every autoplaying video with a pause button.
**Do** route all motion through `--ease-out` and the four durations (160, 240, 420, 560 ms), and drop transforms under Reduce Motion.
**Do** show missing material as a dashed, bracketed placeholder.
donts: **Don't** introduce a site accent or tint the stage; the products are the only colour.
**Don't** use a product's colour outside its own tile or story.
**Don't** cast a shadow from anything but the phone.
**Don't** set prose or the display, section, step or title levels in Geist Mono; the only mono headings are agent names, which are identifiers.
**Don't** use icon fonts or third-party icon sets; draw icons on the 24-unit, 1.5-stroke grid.
**Don't** fall back to a grid of same-size project cards or a split hero with a badge row.
